info.title: Workspaces API
info.description: Spaces, tasks, task actions, comments, folders and the task-sync routes. Task-sync routes also accept an integration token (`oauth2`); every other route needs a user session or API key.

get.description: Returns every space in the account. The response always includes a built-in `ESCALATE` space (used for human-in-the-loop escalations from flows); it cannot be updated or deleted.

patch.description: Merges the fields you send over the stored space — send only the fields you are changing. The built-in `ESCALATE` space cannot be updated and returns 403.

202.description: Update accepted, with a background re-assignment queued. This happens when a priority you removed was still in use by existing tasks — those tasks are reassigned to the fallback priority (the space's default, or the first remaining one).

delete.description: Deletes a space and purges its tasks, comments, and files. Irreversible. The built-in `ESCALATE` space cannot be deleted and returns 403.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many results to return at most. `has_more` tells you whether another page exists.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: If there are more results than the limit, offset can be used to get to the next batch of results

patch.description: Changed: optional `If-Match`. Compare-and-set: a lost race is re-checked up to 3 times, then 409 with the current task. Changing or clearing the `external_id` of a mapped task answers `409 external_id_immutable`. A `parent` needs `tasks:read` on the parent's space.

delete.description: Changed: optional `If-Match`. Check-then-purge, with no compare-and-set. Publishes `task-deleted` and tombstones the task's external ids. With `delete_subtasks=true`, subtasks in spaces the caller cannot write are left behind.

put.summary: Create or update a task checklist action
put.description:
Upsert a checklist action on a task. There is no separate create endpoint — PUT is used for both create and update.

Omit `id` to create a new action (the server assigns one); pass an existing `id` to update that action. `description` is required on every write, including updates that only change `done`.

The response echoes back the action as submitted, not the stored record — it does not reflect how a partial update merged with the existing action.

A new action without a valid resource is refused with 400, and the error names the accepted resource types. Editing a stored action keeps its existing shape.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

200.description: The action as submitted (echoed back, not read back from storage).

400.description: Bad request: missing description, a new action with no resource, an unknown `resource_type`, a malformed `resource_id`, a `record_config` not attached to the task's space, or a `todo` with no items.

get.summary: List task checklist actions — currently unavailable
get.description:
Intended to return the checklist actions on a task, but this endpoint is currently misrouted server-side and always responds with a 400 validation error instead of a list.

Until this is fixed, checklist actions are write-only: keep track of the `id` you get back when you create or update an action, since it cannot be listed or read back afterward.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

delete.description: Removes one checklist action. Returns `{ "message": "success" }` with a 200 status.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Action id (assigned by the server unless you supplied one on create).

put.summary: Create or update a task by external id
put.description: Idempotent. Creates (201) when the id is new in this space and namespace, otherwise updates (200). Needs `tasks:write` on the space. A deleted task's id answers 410 forever. Percent-encode the external id.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Caller's id, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8, any characters except `/` (`400 invalid_request`). Percent-encode it; an encoded `/` never reaches the service because the gateway decodes it before routing.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional task version. A mismatch returns 409 `version_conflict`; a non-integer returns 400 `bad_if_match`. `0` matches a legacy task with no version.

400.description: Bad request. `invalid_request` for a bad `external_id` or `bad_if_match` for a non-integer `If-Match`; other failures carry no `code`.

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

503.description: The integration check could not run. Retry. `code` is `storage_unavailable`.

get.description: Every task, comment and action write in the space, deletes included, for 30 days. The feed does not hide the caller's own writes: filter on `origin`. Needs `tasks:read`.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque; the `next_cursor` of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 500. Default 100.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC 3339. Used only when there is no cursor.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

410.description: `cursor_expired`: the cursor is older than retention. Resume from `next_cursor`.

503.description: A backing store is unreachable. Retry. A feed read failure carries no `code`; `storage_unavailable` is set only when the integration check could not run.

post.description: Creates a space with the source's default status, statuses, priorities, tags and folders. Not tasks, description, record configs or bindings. People only: integration tokens are refused. `staging: true` needs an account root or admin.

409.description: `space exists`: a Space with the new id already exists.

502.description: The space was created but not every folder was copied.

503.description: The source space could not be read. Retry.

post.description: Account root or admin only. Deletes up to 2000 live and archived tasks per call through the normal delete path (events are published, external ids tombstoned). Call again until `remaining` is 0.
